entities.name: St. Michael the Archangel Cathedral, Tegucigalpa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Michael the Archangel Cathedral is a Catholic temple in Tegucigalpa, Honduras. It is well known for being the biggest Catholic church during colonial times and one of the most well preserved historical buildings in Honduras.
